# CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives

## Overview

Build a bold, modern landing page for **CreativeHub**, an online learning platform for creative professionals, hobbyists, and aspiring artists. The page should feel energetic and inspiring — like stepping into a vibrant creative studio. The goal is simple: get visitors excited about the platform and drive them to start a free trial.

## Vibe & Visual Direction

Think **Skillshare meets Dribbble** — playful yet polished. Use a vibrant color palette anchored by a deep navy or charcoal background in the hero with pops of coral/orange, electric green, or warm yellow as accent colors. Typography should be bold and contemporary — a chunky geometric sans-serif for headlines (like Plus Jakarta Sans or similar) paired with a clean body font. Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, and subtle hover animations will reinforce the modern, approachable feel.

## Key Priorities

- **Hero conversion flow**: The hero is the most critical section. It needs to immediately communicate the value prop and present two clear sign-up paths (Google and email). Make these CTAs impossible to miss. The category pills beneath should feel browsable and inviting.

- **Course category tabs**: The tabbed course grid is the core interactive experience. Switching between categories (Featured, Music, Drawing & Painting, etc.) should feel instant and smooth. Each course card needs a thumbnail, title, instructor name, student count, and duration — make them visually rich.

- **Teacher carousel**: The horizontal scrolling teacher section should feel tactile and explorable, with clear navigation affordances (arrows or scroll indicators).

- **FAQ accordion**: Clean expand/collapse behavior — only one item open at a time feels best here.

- **Stats section**: The platform numbers (425k+ members, 30k+ classes, etc.) should land with visual impact — large type, maybe a contrasting background band.

## Note

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section list, data content, and interaction specs. The page is responsive, light mode only.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    :root {
      --black: #0B0B0F;
      --dark: #111118;
      --dark-surface: #1A1A24;
      --green: #55DA9B;
      --purple: #5620C1;
      --purple-light: #7B4FE0;
      --coral: #FF6B6B;
      --orange: #FF8C42;
      --yellow: #FFD166;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --gray-50: #F8F9FA;
      --gray-100: #F0F1F3;
      --gray-200: #E0E2E6;
      --gray-300: #C4C8CF;
      --gray-400: #9DA3AD;
      --gray-500: #6E7581;
      --gray-600: #4A5060;
      --gray-700: #2D3240;
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --transition: 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      color: var(--black);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* ===== HEADER / NAV ===== */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(11, 11, 15, 0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }

    .header .container {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }

    .logo {
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      text-decoration: none;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .logo span { color: var(--green); }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      color: var(--gray-300);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--white); }

    .nav-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .btn-ghost {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--gray-300);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-family: inherit;
    }

    .btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--white); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--black);
      border: none;
      padding: 10px 22px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-family: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: #3FC886;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(85, 218, 155, 0.3);
    }

    .mobile-menu-btn {
      display: none;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 4px;
    }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      background: var(--black);
      padding: 140px 0 80px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -200px;
      right: -200px;
      width: 600px;
      height: 600px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(86, 32, 193, 0.2) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -200px;
      left: -100px;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(85, 218, 155, 0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero .container {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(85, 218, 155, 0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(85, 218, 155, 0.2);
      color: var(--green);
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5.5vw, 4rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
    }

    .hero h1 .highlight {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green), var(--purple-light));
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn-google {
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--black);
      border: none;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-family: inherit;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .btn-google:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    }

    .btn-google svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    .btn-email {
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--black);
      border: none;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-family: inherit;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .btn-email:hover {
      background: #3FC886;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(85, 218, 155, 0.3);
    }

    .hero-legal {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      max-width: 500px;
      margin: 0 auto 48px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .hero-legal a {
      color: var(--gray-400);
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .category-pills {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .category-pill {
      background: var(--dark-surface);
      color: var(--gray-300);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .category-pill:hover {
      background: var(--purple);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--purple);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    /* ===== FEATURES / VALUE PROPS ===== */
    .features {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .features .container { text-align: center; }

    .section-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      color: var(--purple);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.6rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto 52px;
    }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 28px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 36px 28px;
      text-align: center;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      border: 1px solid transparent;
    }

    .feature-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      border-color: var(--gray-200);
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
    }

    .feature-icon.green { background: rgba(85, 218, 155, 0.15); color: var(--green); }
    .feature-icon.purple { background: rgba(86, 32, 193, 0.12); color: var(--purple); }
    .feature-icon.orange { background: rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.12); color: var(--orange); }
    .feature-icon.coral { background: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.12); color: var(--coral); }

    .feature-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .feature-card p {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* ===== STATS ===== */
    .stats {
      background: var(--black);
      padding: 80px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .stats::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 32, 193, 0.08), rgba(85, 218, 155, 0.05));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 40px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .stat-item {
      text-align: center;
    }

    .stat-value {
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4.5vw, 3.4rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .stat-value .accent { color: var(--green); }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .stat-item:nth-child(4) .stat-value .star {
      color: var(--yellow);
    }

    /* ===== COURSES ===== */
    .courses {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .courses .container { text-align: center; }

    .course-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 44px;
    }

    .course-tab {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      color: var(--gray-500);
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-family: inherit;
    }

    .course-tab:hover {
      color: var(--black);
      border-color: var(--gray-300);
    }

    .course-tab.active {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--black);
    }

    .courses-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .course-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }

    .course-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }

    .course-thumb {
      width: 100%;
      height: 160px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-thumb-inner {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2.2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .course-thumb-inner.t1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF6B6B, #FF8C42); }
    .course-thumb-inner.t2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5620C1, #7B4FE0); }
    .course-thumb-inner.t3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2193b0, #6dd5ed); }
    .course-thumb-inner.t4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #11998e, #55DA9B); }
    .course-thumb-inner.t5 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FC466B, #3F5EFB); }
    .course-thumb-inner.t6 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f7971e, #ffd200); }
    .course-thumb-inner.t7 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6441A5, #2a0845); }
    .course-thumb-inner.t8 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00b4db, #0083B0); }

    .course-duration-badge {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 8px;
      right: 8px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }

    .course-info { padding: 18px; }

    .course-info h3 {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    .course-instructor { font-weight: 600; color: var(--gray-600); }

    .course-meta .dot {
      width: 3px;
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--gray-300);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .course-students {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    /* ===== CREATIVE FEED ===== */
    .creative-feed {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .creative-feed .container { text-align: center; }

    .feed-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 28px;
      margin-top: 52px;
    }

    .feed-card {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 44px 32px;
      text-align: left;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .feed-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 4px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl) 0 0;

    .feed-card:nth-child(1)::before { background: var(--green); }
    .feed-card:nth-child(2)::before { background: var(--purple); }
    .feed-card:nth-child(3)::before { background: var(--orange); }

    .feed-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      border-color: var(--gray-200);
    }

    .feed-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .feed-card:nth-child(1) .feed-icon { background: rgba(85, 218, 155, 0.15); }
    .feed-card:nth-child(2) .feed-icon { background: rgba(86, 32, 193, 0.12); }
    .feed-card:nth-child(3) .feed-icon { background: rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.12); }

    .feed-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .feed-card p {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.6;

    .teacher-carousel-wrapper {

    .teacher-carousel {

    .teacher-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .teacher-card {

      flex-shrink: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      scroll-snap-align: start;

    .teacher-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }

    .teacher-avatar {

      height: 200px;

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);

    .teacher-card:nth-child(1) .teacher-avatar { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF6B6B, #FF8C42); }
    .teacher-card:nth-child(2) .teacher-avatar { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5620C1, #7B4FE0); }
    .teacher-card:nth-child(3) .teacher-avatar { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #11998e, #55DA9B); }
    .teacher-card:nth-child(4) .teacher-avatar { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2193b0, #6dd5ed); }
    .teacher-card:nth-child(5) .teacher-avatar { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f7971e, #ffd200); }
    .teacher-card:nth-child(6) .teacher-avatar { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FC466B, #3F5EFB); }
    .teacher-card:nth-child(7) .teacher-avatar { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6441A5, #2a0845); }
    .teacher-card:nth-child(8) .teacher-avatar { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00b4db, #0083B0); }

    .teacher-details {
      padding: 18px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .teacher-details h3 {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .teacher-details p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .carousel-nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 32px;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--black);
    }

    /* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
    .testimonials {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .testimonials .container { text-align: center; }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
      margin-top: 52px;
      text-align: left;

      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;

      { title: "Learn Video Editing With Premiere Pro For Beginners", instructor: "Jordy Vandeput", students: "17,887", duration: "3h 44m", thumb: "t7", categories: ["featured", "film"] },
      { title: "iPhone Photography Essentials: Take Pro Photos With Your iPhone", instructor: "Sean Dalton", students: "13,423", duration: "1h 34m", thumb: "t8", categories: ["featured", "photo"] }
    ];

    const emojis = { t1: "\u{1F3A8}", t2: "\u{1F4F1}", t3: "\u{1F5BC}", t4: "\u{2B1B}", t5: "\u{1F916}", t6: "\u{270F}", t7: "\u{1F3AC}", t8: "\u{1F4F7}" };

    function renderCourses(category) {
      const grid = document.getElementById('coursesGrid');
      const filtered = category === 'featured'
        ? allCourses
        : allCourses.filter(c => c.categories.includes(category));

      const courses = filtered.length > 0 ? filtered : allCourses;

      grid.innerHTML = courses.map(c => `
        <div class="course-card">
          <div class="course-thumb">
            <div class="course-thumb-inner ${c.thumb}">${emojis[c.thumb]}</div>
            <span class="course-duration-badge">${c.duration}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="course-info">
            <h3>${c.title}</h3>
            <div class="course-meta">
              <span class="course-instructor">${c.instructor}</span>
              <span class="dot"></span>
              <span class="course-students">

                ${c.students}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    // Tab switching
    document.querySelectorAll('.course-tab').forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.course-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
        tab.classList.add('active');
        renderCourses(tab.dataset.category);
      });
    });

    renderCourses('featured');

    // FAQ accordion — one open at a time
    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const item = btn.parentElement;
        const isOpen = item.classList.contains('active');

        document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(i => {
          i.classList.remove('active');
          i.querySelector('.faq-answer').style.maxHeight = null;
          i.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });

        if (!isOpen) {
          item.classList.add('active');
          const answer = item.querySelector('.faq-answer');
          answer.style.maxHeight = answer.scrollHeight + 'px';
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        }
      });
    });

    // Teacher carousel
    const carousel = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
    const scrollAmount = 284;

    document.getElementById('carouselPrev').addEventListener('click', () => {
      carousel.scrollBy({ left: -scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
    });

    document.getElementById('carouselNext').addEventListener('click', () => {
      carousel.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
    });

    // Scroll animation observer
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

    document.querySelectorAll('.animate-in').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
  </script>
